units.source_text: 次日，四位侍从薰君送一封信给这里的藤侍从，信中说道：“昨夜举止错乱，不知诸君如何见笑。”

en.t: The next day, Lord Kaoru, who held the Fourth Rank and served as an attendant, sent a letter to the Fuji attendant here, saying in it, "Last night my behavior was disordered; I do not know how you all may be laughing at me."

units.source_text: 他准备给玉鬘尚侍看到，故信中多用假名。

en.t: He intended for Tamakazura, the Naishi no Kami, to see it as well, so he used many kana in the letter.
